summary: Pre-deployment review of timeline revision scheduling, pulse integration, layout countdown, repo double-click, and mobile responsiveness. Backend: 28/29 passing (1 seed-idempotency assertion expected fail because demo already seeded). All new features verified end-to-end: scheduling a revision for TODAY bumps both due_timeline_revisions and due_revisions in /api/pulse and adds a 'Complete N due revisions' mission item; completing the revision decrements both counters; /api/timeline?start=...&end=... returns virtual scheduled_revisions even when parent date is outside the range. Frontend: countdown widget renders '187d : 22h : 05m' format, repository double-click opens edit modal (single click does not), mobile hamburger reveals 4 nav links, /log /timeline /solve/repository have zero horizontal overflow on 390px viewport. ONE responsive issue found: /pulse Subject Completion rows overflow by ~51px on mobile (407px content in 390px viewport).

minor.issue: Idempotency test in legacy backend_test.py expects seeded=True on first call, but DB is pre-seeded per problem statement, so the assertion is environment-dependent (not a real bug).

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile (390px viewport), each subject row uses a flex layout that totals ~407px width, causing /pulse to overflow horizontally by ~51px. Other pages (/log /timeline /solve/repository) are fine.
Mission items render correctly but lack data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="mission-item-<id>"); request implied per-item testids would be useful for testing.

action_items: Fix /pulse Subject Completion responsive layout: make the row flex-wrap or shrink inner widgets (e.g. progress bar w-24 + label) so total <= 390px, or wrap the card in overflow-x-auto with min-w-0 on children.
(Optional, nice-to-have) Add data-testid="mission-item-<id|index>" attributes to /pulse mission rows for stable selectors.
(Optional) Update legacy test_seed_demo_idempotent in backend_test.py to tolerate pre-seeded DB (assert j1.get('seeded') in (True, False)).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/pulse builds due_timeline_revisions by loading all timeline docs with non-empty scheduled_revisions into memory and looping in Python; fine for single-user MVP but should move to a $unwind/$match aggregation if data grows.
server.py timeline list endpoint executes two find() queries when range is supplied, then merges in Python; consider a single $or query for performance.
Most endpoints accept Dict[str, Any] payloads instead of Pydantic models; OK for an internal single-user app but reduces input validation coverage.

success_rate.backend: 100% on new feature tests (3/3 scenarios + 6/6 regression paths); 28/29 overall (1 unrelated env-dependent assertion)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% (5/6 critical checks pass; 1 mobile overflow on /pulse)

seed_data_creation: All created test data (TEST_review_entry, TEST_range_entry, TEST_question, TEST_bulk1/2, TEST_log) is deleted in test teardown; demo seed left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend new endpoints (schedule-revision, complete-revision, /api/pulse new fields due_srs/due_timeline_revisions, /api/timeline with scheduled_revisions virtual items) all work. To rerun: export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pre_deploy_review.py -v. Frontend: only known issue is /pulse Subject Completion row width on 390px viewport (~51px overflow).
rca of the issue: Mobile /pulse overflow RCA: The 'Subject Completion' card contains 12 rows, each a flex with subject code + name (truncated), a w-24 (96px) progress bar, and a percent column. The combined natural width plus the card's outer padding pushes the inner row to 407px, exceeding the 390px viewport. The bar is fixed-width (w-24) and the name column has no min-w-0/flex-1 shrink behaviour. Fix: either reduce the bar to w-16 on mobile, set min-w-0 on the truncating name column, or apply grid-cols-[auto_1fr_auto_auto] with a sm: breakpoint variant similar to what was already done on Log/Timeline.
